scope_note: Half-ton Suburban only: C14/K14 Carryall (1960-66), C10/K10 (1967-86), R10/V10 (1987-88), R1500/V1500 (1989-91). Independent sources: GM literature (one source, Suburban brochures where archived, otherwise C10-series truck brochures), Hagerty Valuation Tools (one source; C10/K10 Carryall rows 1960-63, C10/K10 Suburban pages 1964-80, 'Suburban' pages 1981-91), Wikipedia (one; generation-level engine lists), EPA (1984+), Old Cars Weekly (1966). NHRA has no Suburban rows. Half-ton Suburbans over 6000 lb GVW (C10 from about 1975) carried heavy-duty-emissions ratings, which often differ from C10 pickup ratings.
three_quarter_ton_only_note: Engines in the 3/4-ton (C20/K20, later R/V20 and R/V2500) Suburban but not the half-ton, not recorded: 327 V8 in 1965 (C20/C30 only); 292 six 1973-79 (not in any half-ton Suburban spec table); 454 V8 1980-91 (C20/R20/R2500 2WD only: 1981-82 LE8 210 hp, 1983-86 230-240, 1987-91 TBI 230); 400 small block in 1980 (K20 only); heavy-duty 350 LT9 (1982+) and 2500-series L05 (190-195 hp); 6.2 LL4 heavy-duty diesel (20 series, 148-155 hp); GMC 305 V6 (GMC Suburban only).
excluded_note: 261 six (1962): Chevrolet's 1962 C10-C40 brochure lists it for all light-duty models, but no Suburban source does. Oldsmobile 350 diesel LF9 (1978-81): C10 pickup only, never in Suburban literature. 350 2-bbl (145 hp, 1974-76): pickup engine, absent from Suburban spec tables. 1969 second '350' in the Suburban brochure: unrated, unconfirmed.
